meta.dataset: HINT3 v1 full (Arora et al., EMNLP 2020 Insights Workshop, arXiv:2009.13833)
meta.protocol: open-set: train on in-scope intents only; answer only if max prob >= t, else NO_NODES_DETECTED

shipped_row.selected_on: highest train out-of-fold CV macro-F1 among non-constant arms (no test)

gate_definitions.A: correct = (thresholded pred == gold) over all test items; the output we would ship
gate_definitions.B: correct = (argmax == gold) over gold-in-scope items only; comparable to banking77/ToxicChat/CUAD reference rows

band_router_diagnostic_A.note: band position chosen on test -> OPTIMISTIC; diagnostic only, shows whether errors are concentrated anywhere at all

shipped_row.framing: coverage/cost result only; this project measured out-of-fold that a cascade never beats the better base model

dialogflow.note_best_is_optimistic: threshold chosen on test; optimistic, applied symmetrically to all methods
